finalProject.prompt: Explain how Teddy Pendergrass blended powerful vocals, emotional vulnerability, and the Philly Soul sound to become a foundational figure in R&B. Compare ONE track from his Blue Notes era (If You Don’t Know Me by Now) with ONE track from his solo career (Close the Door), and identify TWO modern artists influenced by Teddy.
